title: Grateful Dead Live at Rich Stadium on 1993-06-13
source: Source: Master Audience cassette Transfer Date: 2011-02-15; Equipment/Lineage:  2 DAK 5245 Microphones and 2 Realistic PZM Mics(Mounted on 1'x 1'x 3/8" plexiglass)>Realistic 4 channel Mixer>Sony D6C Portable Stereo Cassette Recorder> Master cassette(TDK SA-X90)>Yamaha Natural Sound Stereo Cassette Deck K-902>SigmaTel Audio Sound Card/CD Wave Editor(tracking)>Traders Little Helper(flac level 8); Note: This was recorded with 2 sets of mics, 4 channels, mixed down to 2 channels. The mics were mounted on a stand 8' in height. We were located in the designated "taper" section, on the floor, behind the soundboard

ai_review.summary: High‑fidelity stadium tape with surprisingly clear sound, though no musical details are provided
ai_review.review: The sole review praises the recording’s audio quality, calling it a very nice sounding stadium tape – an impressive feat given the typical challenges of large‑venue audience recordings. No comments on the performance or setlist were offered, so the musical aspect remains unassessed.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights excellent sound quality for a stadium tape; lacking any performance commentary, the rating leans on recording merit alone.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review notes the tape sounds very nice and clear despite being captured in a large stadium environment.
